name: Alexander Volkov

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (79 in height, 80 in reach, orthodox, born 1988-10-24). Weigh-in weight not looked up.

photo_coverage: Good. 16 photos, 11 from Oct 2025 to Oct 2026. Frontal: ESPN studio headshot and stance cutout (Oct 2026). Three-quarter: UFC 321 and UFC 328 ceremonial face-offs, UFC 328 fight close-ups. Profile: clean left profile (UFC 328 flex) and right near-profile (UFC 333 weigh-in, Oct 2026). Body: Oct 2026 and Dec 2024 studio cutouts, fight photos showing the back. Only 2 files are freely licensed (CC BY-SA 2016 gym portrait, CC BY 2024 face-off still); the rest are reference-only.
two_looks: His hair is now long (shoulder length, about 25-30 cm). Fight night (UFC 321 Oct 2025, UFC 328 May 2026): pulled back in several tight braids running from the hairline over the crown, so the head reads sleek and close to the skull with the braids ending at the nape. Weigh-ins and media: worn loose to the shoulders with a centre part (2025-26), or wet and slicked straight back (UFC 333 week, Oct 2026). This sheet targets fight night (braided); the loose and slicked looks are described alongside.

face.shape: Long, narrow face: a tall rectangle-to-oval, with a very long midface and a long chin. Widest at the cheekbones and jaw angles, which are about equal, so the sides run nearly parallel with little taper. In profile the face is flat-fronted with a straight forehead-to-nose line.
face.jaw: Angular and lean, moderately wide, with clean angles set low and back under the ears. The jawline is sharp under the light stubble; no fullness under the chin.
face.chin: Tall and long, slightly squared at the bottom, moderately projecting (in the left profile it sits roughly level with the lower lip). No cleft.
face.cheekbones: Moderately high and fairly flat, with hollows below them; deep nasolabial folds run from the nose to the mouth corners.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate. The eyes sit a little deep under it; the brows sit low and close to the upper lids.
face.forehead: High and broad, with several deep horizontal lines and a vertical crease between the brows when he frowns. In profile it slopes back gently. Hairline: M-shaped with recessed temples and a forward central section, most visible when the hair is slicked back.

eyes.shape: Almond, medium-small aperture, upper lids slightly heavy; fine lines under and beside the eyes. Outer corners level.
eyes.size: Medium-small for the long face, partly shadowed by the brow.

eyebrows.thickness: Medium-thin, a little sparse at the tails.
eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight and low; the inner ends angle slightly down toward the nose, giving a stern resting look.
eyebrows.colour: Light brown, darker than the hair ends.

nose.bridge: High and straight; in the left profile it is straight to very faintly convex.
nose.tip: Rounded and slightly bulbous, pointing straight ahead to slightly down.
nose.fight_damage: None obvious; the bridge looks centred in the 2026 studio photos.

mouth.upper_lip: Thin, with a soft cupid's bow
mouth.lower_lip: Thin to medium, a little fuller than the upper
mouth.resting_expression: Lips closed, corners slightly down; serious, unsmiling stare in studio and face-off photos.

ears.protrusion: Stand out moderately from the head, especially with the hair slicked or braided back.
ears.cauliflower_ear: No clear cauliflower. Side views (left ear in the UFC 328 flex photo, right ear in the UFC 328 face-off) show normal folds; frontally the rims look thick.

face.notable_marks_scars: A small raised mole on his right cheek just beside the nostril, and a short curved scar or crease (about 1.5 cm) on his upper left cheek below the outer eye; both are clear in the Oct 2026 studio photos. Deep forehead lines and crow's feet.

hair.style: Long, straight to slightly wavy, about shoulder length. Fight night: tight braids (about six to eight) from the hairline straight back over the crown, close to the scalp (UFC 321, UFC 328). Weigh-ins and media: loose with a centre part, falling past the ears to the shoulders (Oct 2025, May 2026), or wet and slicked straight back off the forehead (Oct 2026). In June 2024 it was still short to medium (about 8-10 cm, swept back).
hair.length_note: Shoulder length when loose; braided flat to the scalp on fight night.
hair.colour: Dark blond to light ash-brown, with lighter, sun-faded ends; reads medium brown when wet.
hair.colour_method: Mean of the six lit samples is #7b614d; set slightly warmer because the Cageside stage light desaturates. Add the highlight colour on the ends when the hair is loose.
hair.hairline: M-shaped with clearly recessed temples and a forward central section.

facial_hair.detail: Light stubble about 2-4 mm over the chin, jaw, upper lip and lower cheeks (Oct 2026 studio and fight-night photos). Around Oct 2025 it was a little fuller, close to a very short beard.
facial_hair.colour: Blond-brown with a ginger cast; lighter than the brows.
facial_hair.density: Even but light; skin shows through.
facial_hair.shape: Natural cheek line at mid-cheek, low neckline.

tone_samples.light: studio, warm saturated grade, slight shadow
weigh-in stage video still, shadow side

skin.tone_hex_method: Mean of the 10 samples not marked excluded (9x9-pixel medians). Studio samples alone average #d2866c (warm, saturated); stage samples alone average #c19a89 (cool, grey).
skin.tone_note: Fair skin. The ESPN grade pushes it orange-red and the Cageside stage light pushes it grey-beige; the truth sits between, a little lighter than the kept mean because the UFC 333 cheek is in shadow. Comparable to the Aspinall (#d48977) and Gaethje (#dc9b8b) sheets.
skin.undertone: Neutral to pink, with a ruddy flush on the nose, cheeks and around the eyes.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles on the face. Several small moles on the chest and abdomen (Dec 2024 cutout). Light, sparse body hair.
skin.texture_pick_reason: Age 38 maps to middleage; its swatch (#e8ccb2) is lighter than the target so the multiply tint can reach #d49b86.

body.build: Very tall (201 cm) and long-limbed, rangy rather than bulky for a heavyweight. Long torso and very long legs.
body.body_fat_notes: Dec 2024: lean with faint upper abs. Oct 2026: smooth midsection without visible abs and slight softness at the lower belly, still lean overall.
body.shoulders: Broad but sloping, with rounded, moderate deltoids; not heavily trapped.
body.chest: Moderate, flat pecs with a clean lower edge.
body.arms: Long and lean, defined forearms; upper arms moderately muscular, not thick.
body.waist: Relatively narrow for a heavyweight, mild V-taper.
body.legs_calves: Very long legs with lean thighs and slim, long calves; long feet.
body.posture: Upright and tall, shoulders relaxed and slightly forward, chin level; long arms hang with gloves near mid-thigh.
body.notable_physique_traits: Height and limb length; long neck and long face; large Japanese-style tattoo work over the whole back and, since 2026, the right chest, shoulder and arm.

fight_posture.observed: Fight photos (UFC 328, May 2026): tall and upright, rear (right) glove held high at the cheek, lead arm long; throws straight front kicks to the body from range (Getty 328-b). On top on the mat he postures upright with long arms (UFC 321).
fight_posture.confidence: Medium: from a handful of stills, not video.

tattoos.where: Whole back, from the shoulders to the waist
tattoos.description: Large Japanese-style back piece in heavy black with red accents (flowers or flames), clearly visible from above in the UFC 321 fight photo (Oct 2025). A dark patch on the upper left back is already visible in June 2024.

tattoos.where: Right chest, right shoulder, right upper arm and the right side of the upper back (connected to the back piece)
tattoos.description: Japanese-style black-and-grey tiger with an open mouth on the right upper chest and shoulder, surrounded by waves and cherry blossoms, wrapping over the deltoid and down the upper arm to just above the elbow as a half sleeve. Small red element on the right flank under the arm. New between Oct 2025 (shoulder bare at the UFC 321 weigh-in) and Oct 2026.
tattoos.size: About 35 x 30 cm on the front; continues onto the back

tattoos.where: Left flank, over the lower ribs
tattoos.description: Red-topped black-and-grey piece: a red rounded shape at the top over a column of grey rounded shapes outlined in black (June 2024, Dec 2024, still visible in May 2026).

kit.typical_shorts: Oct 2026 studio (UFC 333 week): red fight shorts with a darker red scalloped feather pattern, black UFC panel and white grid on the waistband, crypto.com logo. UFC 328 fight (May 2026): white shorts with pink-red VOLKOV lettering. UFC 321 fight (Oct 2025): red shorts. Dec 2024 studio: black and grey tiger-stripe shorts with white slashes and red VOLKOV lettering.
kit.gloves: Standard black UFC 4 oz gloves with red cuffs (fight photos).
kit.brand_note: The 2024 kit is Venum; the 2026 studio kit carries only UFC and crypto.com marks.

render_hints.hair: fight night: hair-ponytail01 (pulled back, closest to the braids) tinted #7a5e45; loose look would need a long straight proxy the embed does not have
render_hints.tattoo_priority: Most visible from the front: the RIGHT chest-shoulder tiger and right upper-arm half sleeve (parsed as a right-arm sleeve). From behind: the full back piece in black with red accents.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets. Estimates for standard MakeHuman ear modifiers in case they are added.

notes: Confidence: high for hair states, tattoos, eye colour and build; medium-high for face proportions (good frontal plus both profiles); low-to-medium for exact morph values. Watch for: (1) The long, narrow face is the main likeness cue: keep the long nose, long chin, hollow cheeks and high forehead; a wide or round head stops reading as him. (2) Fight night is braided, slicked-back hair close to the skull, not short hair; a short crop is his 2016-2024 look. (3) Thin lips with slightly down-turned corners and low, straight brows give the stern expression. (4) Tattoo sides are his own: tiger on the RIGHT chest, shoulder and arm (new in 2026), full back piece, red-and-grey piece on the LEFT flank. (5) Very tall and lean: use the full 201 cm and long legs; the body should not look thick. macro/ageOldM 0.2 follows avatar3d.js (38-25)/65; heightUpM 0.5 extrapolates the other sheets' cm-to-slider line (193 cm about 0.32), so scale the mesh to 201 cm if supported.

stance.notes: Tall range kickboxer: upright, long jab and front kicks, keeps distance with in-and-out steps and circles off the fence.
stance.source: Set 2026-11-06 (avatar pass v4) from his documented fighting style (data/scouting/alexander-volkov.json where present) and the reference photos in assets/reference/alexander-volkov/ (ref-getty-ufc321/328 fight photos: tall upright frame at range). The base stance (orthodox/southpaw) is left to the roster data. Fight footage would sharpen these values.
